narrative.intro: Northrop Grumman Systems obligated $2.9B in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Obligations are up 124.5% year over year. The company won 2 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $1.4B. Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing is the dominant market for Northrop Grumman Systems in FY2026 to date, accounting for $2.9B in obligations. Engineering Services shows a much smaller presence, with $1.2M in obligations. Looking back across recent fiscal years, obligations were $1.1B in FY21, $2B in FY22, $2.9B in FY23, $3.5B in FY24, and $1.3B in FY25. Current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity. Award-value totals in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values rather than contract obligations. This snapshot highlights a heavy concentration in missile and space manufacturing and a small footprint in engineering services for the current fiscal year to date.

sections.heading: Where does Northrop Grumman Systems focus its federal work?
